reasoning_trace.value: The paper discusses a novel OFDM-based simultaneous position and orientation detection (SPAO) approach for visible light communication (VLC) systems. The system model includes M LED transmitters and one user device (UD) receiver with photodiodes. The approach aims to alleviate multipath interference and random fading in diffuse scattering environments.

The SPAO problem is formulated as a maximum a posteriori problem, which is non-convex due to the nonlinear relationship between VLC signal waveforms and UD location parameters. A majorization-minimization (MM)-based SPAO algorithm is proposed to address the non-convexity issue.

The proposed MM-based SPAO algorithm is compared with several baseline methods, including RSS-based SPAO, line search-based SPAO, and gradient descent-based SPAO. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm outperforms the baseline methods in terms of localization error and orientation error.

The paper highlights the importance of considering diffuse scattering and random fading in VLC-based SPAO systems. The proposed MM-based SPAO algorithm provides a promising solution for alleviating these effects and achieving accurate localization and orientation estimation.
